claims: The process may use 6 GiB (6,442,467,328 bytes) with the increased-memory-limit entitlement; the shipped configuration keeps the steady-state peak at 5.65-5.73 GB.
On this device and OS the Neural Engine side holds about 1.3x the chunk weight bytes, charged to the app process.
The transient peak of the first decode steps after a load was caused by per-call output allocation; binding preallocated outputs removed it.
